title: Coordenador de Ciência de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais da equipe de Data Science;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Data Science alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente nos processos de recrutamento, desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de profissionais;
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, criando um ambiente propício para aprendizado contínuo e aprimoramento de habilidades;
  • Interagir de forma colaborativa com líderes de outras áreas para compreender suas necessidades analíticas;
  • Participar ativamente na gestão de orçamentos e recursos;
  • Relatar os resultados para a gerência e propor melhorias;
  • Tomar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao direcionamento de projetos de Data Science.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Necessário graduação completa;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado desejável em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas de IA aplicada, incluindo IA Generativa, modelos preditivos e agents.
  • Necessário experiência em liderança, desenvolvimento de talentos e orçamento;
  • Necessário experiência em gestão de projetos de dados;
  • Necessário experiência em técnicas, linguagens e ferramentas de aprendizado de máquina e Data Science, como Python, R, frameworks de IA e Machine Learning, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, Kubeflow, entre outros;
  • Necessário experiência em aplicação de métodos estatísticos e análise preditiva;
  • Necessário experiência em desenvolvimento de pipelines para análise e interpretação de dados, aplicação e produção de algoritmos de IA tradicional, IA generativa e Agentes de IA.
  • Desejável ter atuado utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project);
  • Desejável experiência em Cloud providers;
  • Desejável experiência em práticas de governança de dados e conformidade com regulamentações de privacidade, como GDPR.
  • Desejável experiência em medidas de segurança de dados para proteger a integridade e a confidencialidade das informações.
  • Desejável domínio do Pacote Office e inglês intermediário..


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: 100%Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA tools specialist)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA/Broadcom tols) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.

  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Experience with CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Experience with CA FAVER, CA Allocate (installation, configuration, training).
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Experience with IBM storage tools .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

Junte-se a nós!

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP CPI - Plenio/Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. O candidato ideal terá experiência em arquiteturas de integração, desenvolvimento de interfaces e uso de ferramentas específicas do ecossistema SAP, e deve ter inglês em nível avançado para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

description:

Secondary Hubs: Colombia, Chile


About Allari

Allari is a global technology solutions provider specializing in high-impact JD Edwards ecosystems. We value deep technical expertise and proactive problem-solving, helping our clients navigate complex regulatory and trade landscapes across the globe.


Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the \"plumbing\" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

Core Specialized Requirements

  • Localization & Trade Integration: Proven experience managing the interface between JDE and external Tax/Global Trade platforms.
  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.
  • Fiscal Logic : A deep functional understanding of Brazilian tax calculation (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS) and its impact on Procurement, Sales, and the General Ledger.
  • JDE Orchestrator : Advanced proficiency in building and troubleshooting Orchestrations (including Groovy scripting) for real-time external integrations.


Technical Skills & Experience

  • Core JDE Development: Expert-level mastery of RDA, FDA, BDA, TDA, and C BSFNs.
  • Integration Protocols: High comfort level with Business Services (BSSV), REST/SOAP APIs, and EDI/Flat File processing.
  • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a \"Technical-Functional Bridge,\" understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the \"connectors\" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).
  • English: Intermediate / Preferred. (We prioritize your technical-functional JDE expertise over absolute fluency).
  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.


Apply with your CV in English.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker.   • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.

  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .

  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.

title: \"Arquiteto de Cloud #996719\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

We are seeking an experienced e-commerce Solution Architect to design, scale, and optimize modern digital commerce ecosystems. This role will be responsible for building secure, scalable, and high-performing architecture that supports enterprise-level eCommerce operations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Shopify and Adobe Magento, along with strong experience integrating complex systems across enterprise environments. title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

Respond.io is expanding rapidly, aiming for a $1 billion valuation following our successful Series A funding. We seek a visionary Partnerships Manager to nurture and support our channel partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will drive mutual success through strong relationship management, strategic collaboration, and effective enablement.

  • Identify potential channel partners that align with the company's strategic goals.
  • Develop and execute recruitment strategies to onboard new partners.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing channel partners.
  • Act as the main point of contact for partners, addressing their needs and concerns.
  • Organize regular meetings, business reviews, and performance assessments with partners.
  • Develop and deliver training programs to educate partners on the company's products, services, and sales processes.
  • Provide ongoing support and resources to partners to ensure their success.
  • Collaborate with partners to develop and execute joint business plans to drive sales and market penetration.
  • Monitor and analyze partner performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
  • Achieve sales targets and revenue goals through effective partner management.
  • Gather market insights and feedback from partners to improve product development and strategy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics.

  • Proven track record of successfully managing and growing channel partner relationships.
  • Experienced in building business and marketing plans with Partners.
  • Well-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and able to prioritize.
  • Ability to operate both at a strategic and hands-on level.
  • Fluent in Spanish, English & Portuguese with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • Nimble and agile team player with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.

  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.

Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).
