We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.

Gestão de Manutenção

  • Zelar pelo armazenamento técnico e organização de materiais no almoxarifado e pátios de equipamentos.


Gestão de Contratos e Facilities

  • Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.
  • Controlar escopo, SLAs, custos, desempenho técnico e segurança dos prestadores.
  • Apoiar processos de contratação, renegociação e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Buscar oportunidades de otimização de contratos e redução de custos totais.


Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)

  • Gerir o orçamento anual de manutenção (OPEX) e de CAPEX Sustaining.
  • Elaborar previsões orçamentárias (budget e forecast).
  • Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes; Serviços e contratos
  • Analisar desvios entre planejado × realizado e definir planos de ação.
  • Implementar iniciativas de redução de custo sem aumento de risco operacional.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);

  • Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS

  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction

  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs

  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce

  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)

  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)

  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts

  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy

title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Location: LATAM

Department: Success Department

Role: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)

Mode: Full-time


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Liderança técnica: Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
  • Compreensão do fluxo de valor: Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais: Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
  • Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas: Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
  • Planejamento e design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas;
  • Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe: Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Medição e melhoria de resultados: Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas;
  • Comunicação e apresentação de resultados: Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC;
  • Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio em automação de testes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.

About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Data Scientist
description:
Progress Rail’s data science team is looking for a motivated and talented Data Scientist who will primarily focus on developing Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence based data models for condition-based monitoring of its assets. In this role, the candidate will contribute to the design, development and deployment of world class rail products and services vital to our customer’s needs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced self-starter, strong attention to details, with excellent written and verbal skills. Enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced, environment and is willing to take on roles outside of comfort zone. Technical aptitude and being well versed in Data Science tools and processes is a must. The role will work closely with the different engineering teams.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Key Job Elements

  • Contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of software systems and applications.
  • Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
  • Apply Machine Learning and other advanced analytical techniques to develop models for condition-based monitoring of locomotive systems.
  • Apply Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) to support text mining, document summarization and others.
  • Understand the business needs and develop data-based solutions.
  • Doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner.
  • Supporting field reported issue resolution through data analysis.
  • System integration of Machine Learning models.


Education Requirements


  • B.S, M.S, or PhD degree in quantitative discipline such as data science, data analytics, computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or other related degree.


Technical Skill

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, and relational database systems.

• Hands-on experience across the entire data science project lifecycle , including data acquisition, data cleaning, data engineering, feature scaling, feature engineering, model testing, validation, and data visualization.

• Practical application of machine learning algorithms, such as regression models, XGBoost, neural networks, and others.

• Development of LLM‑based solutions for document search and summarization using RAG architecture.

• Strong applied statistics skills , including distributions, statistical tests, regression techniques, and related analyses.

• Experience with AWS cloud services , including container services, S3, and additional relevant components.

• Advanced data visualization capabilities , using tools such as Power BI and Python Matplotlib to build clear, interactive, and actionable dashboards and reports.

• Strong business acumen , with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to both technical and non‑technical audiences.


Desirable:

Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams.


Soft Skills:

  • Creativity : Proposing innovative and original solutions in order to add value to processes and increase the company's competitiveness.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Analytical Ability: The ability to analyze data and information, regardless of their the relationship between them, to enable logical decision-making, based on data.

title: Event Operations Specialist
description:
About the job


Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.



Who we are


We’re a real Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up—with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Event Operations Specialist provides hands-on support in the planning and delivery of ecoPortal’s sponsored and community events. Working closely with the Events Manager, Events Operations Specialist, Events Co-ordinator, and the wider Marketing team, this role helps ensure events are well-organised, engaging, and run smoothly from start to finish.


By seamlessly overseeing all aspects of event coordination—from initial planning through to post-event analysis—this specialist will play a pivotal role in solidifying and expanding ecoPortal’s influence and engagement globally.


This is a mid- senior role and would suit someone who is passionate about events, is unflappable in the face of multiple competing priorities, has the willingness to jump in and take charge of a large portfolio of events with a cool, calm head.



Key responsibilities


Event Management

  • Plan and execute successful sponsored events in NZ, AU and UK/EU. Full end-to-end management including but not limited to trade shows, conferences, lunches/dinner, awards.
  • Event management includes third party liaison, run pre-event briefings, manage swag, budgeting, logistics, and post-event analysis.
  • Execute full event debriefs at the conclusion of each event, and disseminate thai information to appropriate stakeholders for consideration. And, make recommendations for improvements and future attendance.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team for pre and event follow up and communications.
  • Work closely with the content and creative teams on all event related comms, branding, promotion, collateral and associated marketing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, marketing, and product) to ensure events align with overall business objectives and provide value to attendees.
  • Evaluate the success of events and report on key metrics, including attendance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and ROI.


Community Engagement and Activation

  • Alongside the Head of Events, research the best H&S events in our target regions and recommend future events.
  • Lead ecoPortal's involvement in health and safety networks, infiltrating key communities, where applicable, attending industry gatherings, and establishing partnerships to strengthen ecoPortal’s reputation and presence.
  • Seek out bespoke opportunities for ecoPortal to participate in local, intimate, and partner industry events to increase brand awareness.
  • Develop and manage relationships with our prospects, customers and those in the Health and Safety industry and build a sense of community within ecoPortal’s customer base.
  • Develop and manage relationships with industry influencers, thought leaders, event organisers, and industry professional organisations.



Qualifications & Experience

  • A willingness and a passion to jump in and enjoy the sometimes hectic and unpredictable nature of events!
  • A Bachelor's degree in a suitable field (this may include, but is not limited to these majors) - Business, Marketing/Events, Management, Communications.
  • A minimum of 3 years experience in business events design and execution
  • Very strong organisational skills, you will be dealign with multiple events at any one time and this means you'll need to be an admin wizard.
  • Excellent attention to detail. Managing events across such a busy event calendar means honing in on details, and ensuring all your ducks are in line to ensure smooth execution.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal. With lots of balls in the air it's important that you know how to stay cool and calm, and focused on the task at hand.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, can-do attitude with a willingness to take initiative. This is a senior role - and the expectation is that you'll be able to take ownership of a certain portion of events + mentor and guide others in the team who are more junior.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Previous experience in events, customer service, or marketing is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets and docs, and familiarity with marketing tools like Trello and Hubspot a bonus).



Perks & Benefits:

We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA
description:

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Domínio de Python

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los; entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j); domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Júnior
description:

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: Executivo(a) Comercial | Feira de Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.
